title: Run-Length Encode
summary: Compress consecutive equal characters as character followed by its count.
statement: Compress consecutive equal characters as character followed by its count. Implement `run_length_encode` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: A run ends at the first different character or the end of the string.
Track the run start, emit its character and length, then begin the next run.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the run_length_encode invariant is complete.
Editorial: Track the run start, emit its character and length, then begin the next run. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(n) space.
editorial: A run ends at the first different character or the end of the string. Track the run start, emit its character and length, then begin the next run. This yields O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
